_comment: outsystems-mcp: not a service, no CI, no compiled language, no PRC. Its content is text an LLM agent reads (skills, commands, plugin manifests) plus per-harness assets. The panel we want is narrow: consistency + agent-facing + context-cost, plus the always-on basics (architecture, error-handling). Everything else (test, security's tenant/injection focus, docs-versus-code, deploy safety) either does not apply or would produce false positives on documentation-shaped content.
